extracted.intended_audience: academic researchers and graduate students in finance/accounting and securities regulation; empirical IPO researchers; policymakers interested in disclosure rules
extracted.subtask_description: Empirical variable definitions and measurement rules used to evaluate firm communication (press releases, conference calls, analyst forecasts) before and after the IPO quiet period and related market outcomes (synchronicity, volatility, coverage).

rubrics_metrics.name: Quiet period press releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of firm-initiated news releases in the 20 calendar days prior to quiet period expiration. I manually search the Factiva database and define a press release as any Factiva news item that lists a wire service as its source. The following sources are considered newswires: PR NEWSWIRE, PR NEWSWIRE (U.S.), PR NEWSWIRE ASIA, PR NEWSWIRE DISCLOSE, PR NEWSWIRE EUROPE, PR NEWSWIRE UK DISCLOSE, M2 PRESSWIRE, DOW JONES NEWS SERVICE, BUSINESS WIRE, REUTERS NEWSWIRES, ASSOCIATED PRESS NEWSWIRES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press releases are identified by Factiva articles with a newswire source; measurement window = 20 calendar days prior to quiet period expiration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-quiet press releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of firm-initiated news releases issued in the 20 calendar days after quiet period expiration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measurement window = 20 calendar days after quiet period expiration; same identification rules as Quiet period press releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Δ Press releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Post-quiet period press releases minus quiet period press releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple difference measure using the 20-day pre- and post-windows.

rubrics_metrics.name: R2 (Stock return synchronicity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Stock return synchronicity, defined as the R2 from a regression of daily firm-returns on market returns and industry returns. Market returns and industry returns are weighted by market value. Industry is defined using the 2-digit SIC code in CRSP. Daily return data are from the CRSP daily stock file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: R2 is computed from daily-return regressions; market and industry returns are market-value weighted; industry defined at 2-digit SIC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quiet R2
rubrics_metrics.description: Stock return synchronicity during the IPO quiet period. For IPOs with a 25-day quiet period (i.e., pre-Global Settlement), I measure using daily returns during the quiet period. For IPOs with a 40-day quiet period (i.e., post-Global Settlement), I measure using daily returns for the first 25 days of the quiet period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measurement window depends on era: use full quiet period when 25 days, otherwise first 25 days when quiet period is 40 days.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-quiet R2
rubrics_metrics.description: Stock return synchronicity measured in the first 25 days after the expiration of the quiet period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Post-quiet measurement window = first 25 days after quiet period expiration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Δ R2
rubrics_metrics.description: Post-quiet R2 minus Quiet R2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Difference in synchronicity between the 25-day post window and the quiet-period window.

rubrics_metrics.name: Synch
rubrics_metrics.description: An unbounded measure of synchronicity used in regressions, defined as the log of R2/(1−R2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Logit-like transformation of R2 to produce an unbounded dependent variable for regressions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quiet σ
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard deviation of daily stock returns during the quiet period. The measurement windows are the same as those used in Quiet R2. Daily return data are from the CRSP daily stock file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Volatility measured over the same quiet-period window used for Quiet R2 (25 days or first 25 of 40).

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-quiet σ
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard deviation of stock returns post-quiet period. The measurement windows are the same as those used in Post-quiet R2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Post-quiet volatility measured over first 25 trading days after quiet expiration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Δ σ
rubrics_metrics.description: Post-quiet σ minus Quiet σ.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Difference in daily return volatility between post-quiet and quiet-period windows.

rubrics_metrics.name: MVE
rubrics_metrics.description: Firm market value on the date of quiet period expiration, calculated as stock price (CRSP variable PRC) multiplied by shares outstanding (CRSP variable SHROUT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use CRSP PRC and SHROUT on the quiet-period-expiration date to calculate market value.

rubrics_metrics.name: R&D/Sales
rubrics_metrics.description: R&D intensity in the year of IPO, defined as the level of R&D (Compustat variable XRD) scaled by sales (Compustat variable SALE). Missing values of XRD are set to zero.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set missing XRD to zero (assume no R&D reported); compute ratio using Compustat year-of-IPO data.

rubrics_metrics.name: High R&D
rubrics_metrics.description: An indicator variable equal to 1 if RD/Sales is greater than 0.1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary classification of R&D intensity using a 10% threshold.

rubrics_metrics.name: Underpricing
rubrics_metrics.description: Stock return on the first day of trading after the IPO, based on the Day 1 ending price (from CRSP variable PRC) and the offer price.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure of IPO initial return (underpricing) using CRSP closing price on trading day 1 and the offer price from SDC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analyst coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: The number of I/B/E/S analyst recommendations made within 5 days after quiet period expiration. Recommendations are from the I/B/E/S Recommendations Detail File.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coverage measured as count of recommendations in the 5-day post-quiet window using I/B/E/S recommendations detail data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Δ Trading volume
rubrics_metrics.description: The change in trading volume from during the quiet period to after the quiet period. The measurement windows are the same as those used in Δ R2. Volume is measured as the number of shares traded (CRSP variable VOL) scaled by the number of shares outstanding (CRSP variable SHROUT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute volume per share (VOL/SHROUT) in the pre/post windows and take the difference matching Δ R2 windows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age at IPO
rubrics_metrics.description: Age of IPO firm in years, based on information available at Professor Jay Ritter's website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Firm age sourced from Jay Ritter's IPO data repository.

rubrics_metrics.name: Book-to-market
rubrics_metrics.description: Book-to-market ratio in the year of IPO, calculated as common equity (Compustat variable CEQ) divided by MVE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Compustat CEQ and the computed MVE for the IPO year.

rubrics_metrics.name: H-index
rubrics_metrics.description: Industry competitiveness of the IPO firm's industry, defined as the Herfindahl index of the IPO firm's industry in the year the firm went public. I compute H-index using sales concentration the Compustat segments database (Compustat variable SALES). Industry is defined using the 2-digit SIC code. Smaller values suggest a more competitive industry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute Herfindahl on sales shares across firms within 2-digit SIC using Compustat segments sales; interpret lower values as more competition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer price
rubrics_metrics.description: The IPO firm's offering price (SDC variable USPR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SDC USPR for the IPO offer price.

rubrics_metrics.name: Underwriter rank
rubrics_metrics.description: The mean value of the Carter-Manaster ranking of investment banks identified as Lead Underwriters in SDC. I obtain Carter-Manaster ranking from Professor Jay Ritter's website. Higher values correspond to more reputable investment banks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Average Carter-Manaster scores for lead underwriters; source: Jay Ritter site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Days in registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of days the firm spent in registration prior to going public (SDC variable DAYSINREG).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SDC DAYSINREG to capture pre-IPO registration duration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Retained interest
rubrics_metrics.description: The ratio of shares retained by insiders to shares outstanding after the offering. It is calculated as pre-IPO shares outstanding (SDC variable OUTSTANDING) minus secondary shares offered (SDC variable TOTSECSHMIL) divided by shares outstanding on IPO date (CRSP variable SHROUT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formula: (pre-IPO OUTSTANDING − TOTSECSHMIL) / SHROUT (IPO date).

rubrics_metrics.name: Δ Earnings volume
rubrics_metrics.description: Short-window relative change in trading volume (CRSP variable VOL) around the firm's inaugural earnings announcement as a public company, computed as the log of total shares traded in the trading day window [−4,−2] minus the of total shares traded in the trading day window [−1,+1], with day 0 as the earnings announcement date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use specified short windows around inaugural earnings (pre window [−4,−2], event window [−1,+1]); compute log difference in total shares traded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Earnings return
rubrics_metrics.description: The short-window return around the firm's earnings announcement, over the trading day window [−1,+1].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Event-window return centered on earnings announcement using CRSP returns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quiet period earnings
rubrics_metrics.description: An indicator variable equal to 1 if the firm's inaugural earnings announcement as a public company occurred while still within the quiet period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary flag signifying inaugural earnings occurred before quiet expiration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Earnings press release
rubrics_metrics.description: An indicator variable equal to 1 if Quiet period earnings = 1 and the firm issued a press release to announce earnings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires both inaugural earnings during quiet period and issuance of a press release (as defined by Factiva newswire criteria).

rubrics_metrics.name: Conference call
rubrics_metrics.description: An indicator variable equal to 1 if Earnings press release = 1 and the firm held a conference call to discuss results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conference-call flag conditional on an earnings press release during the quiet period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Log # EPS forecasts
rubrics_metrics.description: The number of unique analysts providing a forecast of earnings per share for the firm's first quarterly announcement after the quiet period expires. Earnings forecasts are from the I/B/E/S Detail History Unadjusted EPS for US Region file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Count unique analysts issuing EPS forecasts in the first quarterly announcement post-quiet; take log in regressions as specified in the paper.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-EPS forecast
rubrics_metrics.description: An indicator equal to 1 if at least one analyst provides a disaggregated (i.e., non-earnings) forecast for the first quarterly earnings release after the quiet period expires. Disaggregated forecasts are from the I/B/E/S Detail History Unadjusted Non-EPS for US Region file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary indicator for presence of any non-EPS (income-statement component) forecasts for the first post-quiet quarter; source I/B/E/S non-EPS file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Q# meet-beat
rubrics_metrics.description: An indicator variable equal to 1 if the firm meets or beats the mean analyst consensus EPS forecast in the initial quarters (up to four) following quiet period expiration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quarterly binary measure for meeting/beating consensus EPS in up to four successive post-quiet quarters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quiet period loudness
rubrics_metrics.description: The log of the number of firm-initiated press releases during the quiet period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a continuous measure of how 'loud' firms are during the quiet period; press releases counted per Factiva newswire rules, then logged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Serious violation
rubrics_metrics.description: An indicator variable equal 1 if the firm gave earnings guidance prior to quiet period expiration or if Conference call = 1. I obtain management forecast data from the I/B/E/S Guidance, CIG First Call, and Capital IQ Company Events databases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary flag for more serious quiet-period rule violations (management guidance or conference call); guidance sources include I/B/E/S Guidance, CIG First Call, Capital IQ events.
